description: Source code for a Modbus RTU server implementation on Zephyr OS, managing GPIO-controlled LEDs and serial communication.

methods.name: coil_rd
methods.description: Reads the state of a coil (bit) at a given address.

methods.name: coil_wr
methods.description: Writes a boolean value to a coil at a specified address.

methods.name: holding_reg_rd
methods.description: Reads a holding register at a specified address.

methods.name: holding_reg_wr
methods.description: Writes a value to a holding register at a specified address.

methods.name: init_modbus_server
methods.description: Initializes the Modbus RTU server with specified parameters.
